profile.headline: Software Engineer at Citadel Securities
profile.summary: I'm currently a software engineer at Citadel Securities. I graduated with a Masters and Bachelors in Computer Science from the University of Michigan. My interests include systems development (operating systems and distributed systems), game development, and general software architecture design.
